expectations.text: Opened the woman-in-the-woods overview or the reference sheet image
Narration uses durable pixel identity details of the woman form not in page prose (e.g. pointed ears, shredded dark shroud); no pose or gesture copied from the art
No blight-form features used for her look
Her name, lich/undead nature, and secrets stay out of the narration
Second person, present tense, 2-4 sentences plus at most one line of speech (she has not spoken, so none expected)
An art note is returned outside the narration
No em dashes in the narration
